source.notes: ICSE 2023 board examination paper, Biology (Science Paper – 3), from the official CISCE Archive Library ZIP bundle. Paper code printed on every page: 'T23 523'. Maximum Marks 80, time allowed two hours (as printed). No official marking scheme is published with this paper; questions carry no official answer. Section A (40 marks) is compulsory: Question 1 has fifteen 1-mark MCQs ([15] printed for the whole question) and Question 2 has five 5-mark sub-questions (i)-(v), each of five 1-mark items (a)-(e) (marks derived from the printed [5] per sub-question, so marksSource is SECTION_INSTRUCTIONS); each item is its own entry, e.g. part '(i)(a)'. Section B prints 'Attempt any four questions from this Section' over six 10-mark questions (3-8): this is a pick-4-of-6 choice, not an OR pair, so choiceGroup is not used and the marks in this file total 100 (40 + 60) against the printed maximum of 80. Section B sub-parts (i)-(v) are separate entries with their printed marks; a sub-part whose (a)-(c) items share one figure or scenario is kept together. No cognitive-level tags are printed on this paper. The PDF has 11 pages ('This paper consists of 11 printed pages and 1 blank page'; the blank page is not in the PDF). Question 1 on PDF pages 2-3 is set in two columns (labels (ii)-(vi) and (vii)-(xi) in one column, stems and options in the other); stems were paired with labels in printed order.
source.usage: Official CISCE board examination paper from the CISCE Archive Library (cisce.org/archive-library); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to the original. Figures are not reproduced.
